test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion loss computation using gtn forward_score and compose on a CTC graph with emissions
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion loss computation using gtn forward_score and compose on a FAL graph with transitions
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG Viterbi path decoding using gtn viterbi_path on composed emissions and transitions graphs
create_emissions_graph: create a linear emissions graph from a probability vector using gtn linear_graph and set_weights
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC lattice graph from a target sequence and blank label using gtn Graph add_node and add_arc
